text: In 1850 a dying mother sends her newborn Alucarda to a stone-walled convent, fearing the devil will claim her. Fifteen years later Alucarda pledges to die alongside the orphan Justine, and in a crypt in the woods they [open the grave of Alucarda's mother|trigger|unsealing what was shut away] and are [seized by a powerful force|threat|being taken over]. As the girls chant for Satan, the nuns and Father Lázaro answer with flogging and [an exorcism that binds Justine to a cross|wrong|the powerful abuse their power].
